cues.title: 一颗分子往回走，整滴墨水却散开
cues.titleEn: One doubles back; the drop spreads
cues.caption: 无规则运动，形成有方向的净扩散。
cues.zh: 盐水为什么会让细胞变瘪？先从一滴墨水找线索。盯住金色的分子，它没有一直向外走，也会折回来。可看整批染料，原先挤在一起的分布逐渐摊开。下面每一条柱子统计同一批分子的位置。分子没有消失，也没有认路；无规则运动的群体结果，才是从浓到稀的净扩散。
cues.en: Why can salt water make a cell shrink? Start with a drop of dye. Follow the gold particle: it doubles back instead of always travelling away from the drop. Yet the whole population spreads. Each bar counts where these same particles are now. None has vanished, and none knows a destination. Random individual motion produces a directional change in the population.

cues.title: 水位停了，水分子没有停
cues.titleEn: The level stops; molecules do not
cues.caption: 混合降低水势，压力抬高水势，净流量由两侧之差决定。
cues.captionEn: Mixing lowers water potential; pressure raises it. Their difference drives net flow.
cues.zh: 漏斗为什么净吸水？看两侧的水势，它比较水发生转移的能量状态。同温同压下，溶质混合降低水势，所以内侧的水平线较低。膜把蔗糖留下，水仍来回运动，净转移却指向水势低的内侧。随着水柱升高，压力又把内侧水势抬高。最后，两侧水平线对齐，水位几乎不再上升。水分子没有停，只是净流量为零；两侧溶质浓度也不必相等。
cues.en: Why does the funnel gain water overall? Compare water potential, the energy condition for water transfer. At equal temperature and pressure, mixing with solute lowers it, placing the inner level below the outer one. The membrane retains sucrose. Water still moves both ways, but net transfer goes toward lower water potential. As the column rises, pressure lifts the inner potential. Eventually the levels align and the column barely rises further. Molecular motion continues, with zero net flow. Solute concentrations need not become equal.

cues.title: 盐没有抽走整个细胞
cues.titleEn: Salt does not remove the whole cell
cues.caption: 失水使细胞变小，也使胞内溶质更浓。
cues.captionEn: Water loss shrinks the cell and concentrates its contents.
cues.zh: 把相同的红细胞放进三种外液。等渗的一组，平均体积稳定；高渗的一组变小。注意里面的方块：膜未破裂时，不透膜的物质留着，离开的主要是水，所以胞内反而变浓。低渗的一组则吸水，可能胀破。不是盐把整个细胞吸走，而是膜两侧的条件改变了水的净转移。
cues.en: Put identical red cells in three baths. The isotonic cell keeps its average volume; the hypertonic cell shrinks. Watch its squares: while the membrane remains intact, retained solute stays inside as water leaves. The contents therefore become more concentrated. The hypotonic cell takes up water and may rupture. Salt has not pulled out the whole cell. Conditions across its membrane have changed the net water transfer.

cues.title: 把失水推理带进植物细胞
cues.titleEn: Bring the argument into a plant cell
cues.caption: 液泡和原生质体缩小，细胞壁留在外面。
cues.captionEn: The vacuole and protoplast shrink inside the wall.
cues.zh: 现在换成紫色洋葱细胞。高浓度蔗糖外液中，水净流出，紫色液泡和原生质体一起缩小。绿色的细胞壁伸缩较小，没有跟着退进去，间隙就出现了。棕色标记提醒我们，间隙里有外液，不是真空。这组可见变化，把细胞变瘪和渗透失水连在一起；所谓质壁分离，是原生质层与细胞壁分开。
cues.en: Now consider purple onion cells in concentrated sucrose solution. Net water loss shrinks the purple vacuole and the protoplast. The green wall is less extensible and stays outside, opening a gap. Brown markers show that external solution fills it: this is not a vacuum. The visible separation connects cell shrinkage with osmotic water loss. Plasmolysis separates the protoplast boundary from the wall.

cues.title: 复原之后，为什么不继续胀大
cues.titleEn: Why recovery does not mean endless swelling
cues.caption: 靠近细胞壁后，膨压抵消进一步吸水。
cues.captionEn: Wall contact builds turgor that opposes further uptake.
cues.zh: 再看同一个仍然存活的细胞，换成低渗外液。水的净转移反过来，液泡变大，原生质体重新靠近细胞壁。看接触处的反向箭头，以及逐渐增加的压力色带：壁的限制让膨压建立起来，继续吸水的驱动被抵消。现在可以预测，给这样的植物细胞更多清水，不等于它会无限膨胀。红细胞缺少这道壁，结果就可能不同。
cues.en: Follow the same viable cell after changing to a hypotonic bath. Net water transfer reverses. The vacuole expands and the protoplast approaches the wall. Notice the opposing contact arrows and the growing pressure bar. The wall supports turgor, which offsets further uptake. We can now predict that adding more fresh water will not make this plant cell swell indefinitely. A red cell lacks that wall and can have a different outcome.

cues.title: 水通道，改变快慢而不是方向
cues.titleEn: Channels change speed, not the driving direction
cues.caption: 水通道加快被动过水，反转梯度也加快失水。
cues.captionEn: Channels speed passive flow, including water loss after reversal.
cues.zh: 膜怎样让水通过？研究者把候选水通道的遗传信息放进卵母细胞，再与对照放入相同低渗外液。有水通道的一组更快膨胀，这支持蛋白质参与水通透的解释。现在做一个教学预测：另取相同起点，把外液改成高渗。两组都失水，有通道的一组仍然更快。通道降低通行阻力，没有给水供能，更不能替水选择永远向内的方向。
cues.en: How does water cross a membrane? Researchers expressed a candidate water-channel protein in oocytes and compared them in the same hypotonic bath. The expressing cells swelled faster, supporting the protein’s role in water permeability. Now make a teaching prediction: reset to identical starting cells and use a hypertonic bath. Both lose water, and the channel-bearing cell again changes faster. A channel reduces resistance. It does not supply energy or force water always inward.

cues.title: 蛋白质，不等于主动运输
cues.titleEn: A protein does not make transport active
cues.caption: 两条被动路径都消耗浓度差，平衡后仍能交换。
cues.captionEn: Both passive routes reduce a gradient; exchange persists.
cues.zh: 把观察对象换成一种被运输的物质。直接穿脂质层，或者借助载体，都可以让浓度差逐渐减小。平衡之后，跟着金色和紫色标记看，物质仍能往返交换，平均分布却不再继续偏向一边。载体提供了一条路，并没有免费重建浓度差。因此，看见膜蛋白还不够；要判断主动还是被动，还得问，运输有没有与能量耦合。
cues.en: Now track a transported substance. Passage through lipids or through a carrier can both reduce a concentration difference. After equilibrium, follow the gold and purple markers: exchange continues, while the average distribution stays balanced. A carrier provides a route; it does not rebuild a gradient for free. Seeing a membrane protein is therefore not enough to identify active transport. We must ask whether the movement is coupled to energy.

cues.title: 用供能对照检验逆势运输
cues.titleEn: Test uphill transport with an energy control
cues.caption: 相同起点，供能的泵才能继续逆势积累。
cues.captionEn: From the same start, only the energized pump accumulates uphill.
cues.zh: 最后让胞内一开始就比胞外更多，两组起点相同。供给ATP的一组，标记物仍经过泵进入，胞内积累继续增加；没有ATP的对照停在起点。不是有一个蛋白就自动产生方向，而是能量释放与转运耦合，才允许这种逆势积累。把这点带回水通道：若没有额外供能，就不能把通道当作把水抽向任意一边的泵。
cues.en: Finally, start with more material already inside, using the same starting distribution in both groups. With A T P supplied, the marked cargo still passes through the pump and accumulates inside. Without that energy supply, the control stays at its starting state. A protein alone does not create uphill transport. Coupling movement to energy release makes this accumulation possible. Carry that distinction back to aquaporin: without an energy source, a channel is not a pump that sends water wherever we choose.

description.zh: 从墨滴的无规则运动到膜两侧的双向交换，用漏斗水柱与细胞变形推导渗透、动平衡和膨压，再预测水通道反转外液后的结果。
description.en: Connect random dye motion and two-way membrane exchange to rising columns, cell shrinkage, dynamic equilibrium and turgor; then predict a reversed aquaporin experiment.
